# Console commands

<!-- Generated by tools/exec_catalog.py; do not edit by hand. -->

Every console command (vanilla `exec function`) in the game's scripts on `vanilla-5.x`: 874 commands. Generated by `python tools/exec_catalog.py`; re-run it when a new game version lands on `vanilla-5.x`.

**Using them.** Type a command in the in-game console (`~`), or run it from a script with `python tools/game.py exec "<call>"`. Write names as listed: case may matter (`addskillpoints` and `addSkillPoints` are separate functions). Arguments: numbers as is; `name` arguments and enum values (`EEffectType`, `ESkill`, `EBaseCharacterStats`, ...) as bare words (`spawn(wolf)`, `buffme(EET_Drunkenness)`); text with spaces in quotes (`additem('Viper School steel sword')`; single quotes work through `game.py exec`). Optional arguments (marked `?`) can be left out.

**Caveats.**

- Commands that only log (`logskills()`, `printinv()`, `statsplayer()`, ...) run, but their output never reaches the script log in the release build. Read state with `modAutomation`'s probes instead (`autoplayer()`, `autoskills()`, ...; see [game-automation.md](game-automation.md#modautomation)).
- Many commands are developer tests from the original production (`test...`, numbered quest tests) and may refer to content or tags that only exist in one place in the world, or do nothing.
- Online command lists describe the legacy game; the hint and the source here are what 5.x does.
- ✔ marks commands tested in game on 5.x; their usage and pitfalls are in [game-automation.md](game-automation.md#setting-up-geralt-and-the-world).

Columns: **Command** is the signature (`?` = optional); **Does** is the first statement of its body, as a hint; **Source** is the file under `scripts/` and line on the baseline branch. Topics are assigned by name, so a few commands sit under a loose fit.
